day_shape: 88 items: CENTCOM downed four Iranian drones near Hormuz and struck radar sites at Goruk and Qeshm, IRGC and IRIB claimed missile strikes on Ali Al-Salem and Bahrain Fifth Fleet, State Dept announced fresh Iran energy-smuggling sanctions, Lebanese President Aoun accused Iran of using Lebanon as a bargaining chip, House rejected Tlaib's Lebanon War Powers resolution 324-92.

threads.label: Hormuz drone incident and US response
threads.summary: CENTCOM said it shot down four Iranian one-way attack drones launched toward the Strait of Hormuz and then struck Iranian coastal radar sites at Goruk and Qeshm Island. CENTCOM also publicly denied Iranian state-media claims that Iran's navy fired warning shots at US warships in the Gulf of Oman, and said USS Tripoli is supporting an ongoing blockade that has redirected 129 vessels and disabled six.

threads.label: IRGC claims strikes on US bases
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB published IRGC statements claiming missile attacks on Ali Al-Salem air base in Kuwait and Fifth Fleet facilities in Bahrain, framed as retaliation. Regime channels also circulated commentary from Velayati and an IRIB tweet mocking US arms sales to host nations.

threads.label: Southern Lebanon clashes and evacuation orders
threads.summary: The IDF reported a firefight in Zawtar al-Sharqiyah that killed two Hezbollah operatives and wounded two Givati officers, separate strikes on a Hezbollah figure said to be operating from a UNIFIL outpost in Burj Qalawiya, and sirens in the Upper Galilee triggered by surface-to-air fire at an IAF aircraft. IDF Arabic spokesperson Avichay Adraee issued evacuation warnings for Armati, Mishghara, Kafr Houna, Sejd and Ansariyeh.

threads.label: Aoun-Tehran row and Lebanon politics
threads.summary: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun told CNN that Iran is using Lebanon as a bargaining chip with Washington, prompting Foreign Minister Araghchi to respond via Defa Press that Iran is not occupying or bombing Lebanon. The US House rejected Rashida Tlaib's Lebanon War Powers Resolution 324-92, the UN announced a $331.5 million additional flash appeal for Lebanon, and Lebanon is weighing its largest amnesty in 35 years.

threads.label: US-Iran diplomacy and sanctions
threads.summary: The State Department announced new sanctions targeting a network said to have smuggled hundreds of millions of dollars in Iranian energy, while Energy Secretary Chris Wright said lower US fuel prices would require a deal with Iran and reopening of Hormuz. Trump claimed Iran retains only around 21% of its missile capacity and said the US could retrieve Iran's uranium without a deal, as Mohsen Rezaei told CNN talks are at a deadlock.

threads.label: Khamenei Khomeini-anniversary messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published an Eid al-Ghadir audio message marking the 37th anniversary of Imam Khomeini's death and the start of Ali Khamenei's leadership, alongside notes framing 'the people' as the source of the Islamic Republic's power. Defa Press and IRIB amplified Velayati's claim of a new global 'geometry of power' and ran a 'Tehran: Frontline of Resistance' exhibition announcement.

threads.label: Iran World Cup visa dispute
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported that the US granted visas to Iran's World Cup players 10 days before their Los Angeles opener, while some staff remain without entry permits. IRIB listed delegation members still without visas including team director Mehdi Mohammadnabi and federation secretary general Hedieh Mombini, citing a New York Times report that more than 12 support staff and managers, including federation head Mehdi Taj, remain unissued.
